max_size_mb.description: Target total file size in megabytes (e.g., 700 for CD-R)

audio_bitrate_kbps.description: Audio bitrate in kilobits per second (typical: 64, 96, 128, 160, 192, 256, 320)

duration_minutes.description: Video duration in minutes (required for calculation)

passes.description: Number of encoding passes: 1 (single-pass) or 2 (two-pass); 2 is recommended
